redFirst.basis: `python3 plugins/audit/tests/test_audit_task.py --selftest` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1, but no test was collected or none reached an assertion: SELFTEST FAILED: 1011/1012 cases passed; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, OLDPWD, PWD; dependencies linked from the project root, entry by entry as symlinks: node_modules - .cache, .vite, .vite-temp are not linked and a new entry a runner makes beside the links stays in the throwaway, but a write into a linked entry lands in the project's own node_modules and is not watched; the user's .npmrc in the home directory dropped (every run has a fresh home)

outcome.technical: Removed the staged .creating file. _create_then now only builds the seed and calls body(config, REAL mpath, seed). _locked_phase_add/_locked_batch_add take seed=None and read it via new _plan_or_seed (two independent copies when the path is absent), so their existing save is the first write of the real path and already holds the first phase; the existing _snapshot/_restore records an absent file as None and restore removes it (pinned by fp10). No emit rewriting, no copy, no _CREATE_SUFFIX, no separate planned_redactions call: the body's save goes through _panel_write._atomic_write_json, which journals redactions for the whole written plan, so P123-R30 is settled by the same change. fp7-fp9 rewritten to the one-name shape (body gets real path and a seed, no file while it runs, nothing left after raise/refusal). Added fp10 (restore removes an absent-before file), fp11 (first add-phase journal row target is docs/audit/audit-plan.json), fp12 (add --from-file: phase.add plus every task.add target the real path, none .creating, no .creating file). test_audit_task.py --selftest 1017/1017 pass, test__deps.py --selftest 314/314 pass. Full sweep and other gates not run (own-tests reading).
outcome.descriptive: A first plan has one name: journal rows, notes and redaction reports all name the real plan path.
